name: jade-if-you-stay-quiet
title: If You Stay Quiet
usage: Jade — déjà généré le 01/09, téléchargement seulement
style: intimate female vocal, extremely close-mic, almost spoken-sung, folk, 76 BPM, sparse piano, faint vinyl, breath and room tone, no drums first verse, no choir, no autotune, cinematic hush
lyrics:
[Verse]
You don't have to fill it
the space between the lines
I hear you in the silence
better than in time

[Verse]
Put the phone face down
leave the song half-played
I only need the breathing
to know you haven't strayed

[Chorus]
If you stay quiet
I can tell the truth
Louder than a microphone
softer than a proof

[Verse]
I almost said forever
I almost said tonight
Then I let the quiet
finish it right

[Chorus]
If you stay quiet
I can tell the truth
Louder than a microphone
softer than a proof

name: jade-unsent
title: Unsent
style: intimate female vocal, close-mic, singer-songwriter, warm nylon guitar, faint tape hiss, 78 BPM, folk-pop, late-night confession, slight rasp, no choir, no drums until second chorus, cinematic quiet
lyrics:
[Verse]
I wrote it on the train
then I wrote it in the dark
Your name still looks too loud
to live inside a heart

[Verse]
I almost pressed send
I almost let it through
The draft is still awake
and I am still with you

[Chorus]
Don't make me say it clean
Don't make it beautiful
Some truths only live
unsent, and that is all

[Verse]
The cursor blinks like rain
on a window I don't close
If you ever find this
you already know

[Chorus]
Don't make me say it clean
Don't make it beautiful
Some truths only live
unsent, and that is all

name: jade-second-cup
title: Second Cup
style: intimate female vocal, close-mic, folk-pop, sunlit kitchen, soft acoustic, light analog pad, 80 BPM, warm, not sad, breathy verse, gentle chorus, no choir, no EDM
lyrics:
[Verse]
The kettle knows your hour
I pour it anyway
Two cups on the table
like you might stay

[Verse]
I don't call it waiting
I call it how I live
The second cup goes cold
and I forgive

[Chorus]
If love is just a habit
then let it be this one
A quiet little kitchen
and the morning almost done

[Verse]
Steam on the window
your chair still slightly turned
I drink the first
I leave the second burned

[Chorus]
If love is just a habit
then let it be this one
A quiet little kitchen
and the morning almost done

name: jade-hotel-window
title: Hotel Window
style: intimate female vocal, close-mic, cinematic folk-electronica, night hotel room, 82 BPM, thin synth under acoustic, city-quiet, slight rasp, no choir, no dance beat, no male vocal
lyrics:
[Verse]
Another hotel window
another borrowed key
The city learns my first name
and never looks at me

[Verse]
I watch the traffic blink
I count the floors below
Every skyline rhymes
when I don't let you go

[Chorus]
Come sit on the sill
don't turn on the light
If we stay this quiet
we might get it right

[Verse]
I leave the curtain open
I leave a little room
In case the night remembers
to send you through

[Chorus]
Come sit on the sill
don't turn on the light
If we stay this quiet
we might get it right

name: jade-nantes-s-allume
title: Nantes s'allume
style: intimate French female vocal, close-mic, acoustic ballad, warm upright piano, 80 BPM, tender, sunlit rain, slight rasp, no choir, no drums first verse, cinematic hush, no autotune
lyrics:
[Couplet]
Il a plu sur la rue Crébillon
comme tous les soirs d'octobre
J'ai laissé le piano ouvert
pour que la pièce ne se ferme pas

[Refrain]
Je chante pour occuper le silence
pas pour qu'on m'entende
Nantes s'allume trop tard
et moi trop tôt

[Couplet]
La Loire passe sans me regarder
elle a mieux à faire
J'ai mis mon manteau sur la chaise
comme si j'allais sortir

[Refrain]
Je chante pour occuper le silence
pas pour qu'on m'entende
Nantes s'allume trop tard
et moi trop tôt

name: jade-maree-basse
title: Marée basse
style: intimate French female vocal, extremely close-mic, dark folk-electronica, thin analog pads, 78 BPM, restrained, Brittany night, breath on the microphone, slight rasp, no choir, no dance beat, cinematic, withheld
lyrics:
[Couplet]
La mer a reculé jusqu'aux parcs
Guérande sent le sel et le fer
Je parle moins que le vent
et le vent n'attend personne

[Refrain]
Si tu m'écoutes de trop près
tu entendras ce que je retiens
Marée basse
je ne dis pas le reste

[Couplet]
Les phares clignent comme des mensonges polis
J'habite le bord, pas le centre
Le silence a pris mon nom
je lui chante le sien

[Refrain]
Si tu m'écoutes de trop près
tu entendras ce que je retiens
Marée basse
je ne dis pas le reste
